_comment: Copy to Channels_Data/<channel>/DATA/<channel>.json. Keys marked (required) must be set; the rest may be empty strings to disable a feature.
BotTwitchAuth: legacy fallback: oauth:xxxx IRC token of the bot account; not needed once the bot account is authorized on the panel's Twitch page
TApiClientId: client id the legacy TApiAccessToken was issued for (token generator); unused once the streamer is authorized on the panel
TApiAccessToken: legacy fallback: broadcaster user token; not needed once the streamer is authorized on the panel's Twitch page
StreamElementsApiToken: JWT token (chat replies and song requests go through StreamElements)
YouTubeApiToken: Google API key for song request validation
ZakazTrekaId: channel points reward id: song request
UvalId: reward id: timeout an unsubscribed user
ApiPublicUrl: https://bot.example.com (public URL of the web panel; OAuth redirect is {ApiPublicUrl}/api/auth/callback)
TApiClientSecret: client secret of your own Twitch application (required): panel login, scope grants and token refresh
ChatTransport: auto | eventsub | irc (default auto: chat via EventSub channel.chat.message when the streamer token has user:read:chat, IRC otherwise)
ApiClientId: client id of your own Twitch application (required): panel login, scope grants and token refresh; defaults to TApiClientId
